◇Задний план (слой цветных полос): ★выбеленная радуга тянется от них к правому верхнему углу кадра, в её конце тихо стоит та белая дверная рама, свет внутри двери ярче окружающего. ★Никто к ней не идёт.
◇Игра: ★у обоих больше нет крупных движений, но оба ещё не успокоились. Его грудь всё ещё вздымается, дыхание с призвуком в нос. ★Голова пса лежит у него в ямке плеча, время от времени поднимается, лизнуть его разок, и снова ложится обратно. ★Его хвост всё ещё виляет — амплитуда меньше, чем только что, но он так и не останавливается, облачные клочья позади него всё время сметаются и движутся. ★Его пальцы один раз сжимаются на загривке пса и так и замирают. ★Он поднимает взгляд и смотрит на далёкую дверь, потом снова опускает глаза на пса. ★И кадр останавливается здесь: два тела, сложенные вместе, хвост, который всё ещё медленно виляет, и медленно текущие вокруг облака.
◇Камера: верхний ракурс прямо сверху вниз, позиция полностью зафиксирована. ★Без наезда, без панорамы, без отъезда, без уменьшения. ★В конце полная неподвижность, рамка ни на йоту не движется, но снимаемые живые: дыхание, хвост, облачные клочья — всё движется. ★Не делать финала, где их поглощает свет. Замысел = не давать «ухода», дать только «всё ещё вместе».
◇Звук: белый шум, два дыхания (одно большое и одно маленькое, одно медленное и одно быстрое), непрерывное шуршание хвоста по облачной поверхности, время от времени влажный звук облизывания, короткое довольное похрюкивание в носу пса. ★Звук не затухает, не завершается — в последнем кадре всё ещё слышно, как движется этот хвост. Нет музыки, нет хора, нет никаких завершающих звуковых акцентов.
◇Фактура: там, где два тела сложены вместе, пучки грубых мазков длинной шерсти и жёсткие грани складок рубашки сталкиваются друг с другом. Невысохшие мокрые следы на его лице — несколько тонких линий кисти чуть светлее окружения. Бумажная фактура в последнем кадре видна отчётливее всего.
◇Переход: ★фрагмент заканчивается, без жёсткой склейки, без ухода в чёрное, без затемнения, без отъезда. Последний кадр = два сложенных вместе тела, хвост, который всё ещё виляет, и текущие вокруг облака.

【Звуковое сведение】★Во всём ролике нет реплик, нет закадрового голоса, нет фоновой музыки. ★Нижний слой всё время — едва слышный высотный белый шум без отражений и эха. Шумы (четыре лапы, удар, облизывание, хвост, метущий облака, занос задних лап, дыхание) все отчётливо выведены перед белым шумом. ★Кривая плотности звука: s1 разреженно → s2~s5 постепенно уплотняется → ★s6~s7 достигает максимальной плотности в ролике (удар, облизывание, дыхание, плач-смех, хвост, метущий облака, — одновременно) → s8 немного спадает, но не прекращается. ★В s3 и s4 не добавлять никакой музыки, никаких струнных, никакого сердцебиения — только его дыхание, придыхания и всё приближающийся звук четырёх лап. ★Звук последнего кадра не затухает, хвост всё ещё слышен. Без субтитров.

【★Предотвращение повторяющихся ошибок★】
·★Ролик обязан остановиться на состоянии, когда два тела лежат вместе, а хвост всё ещё виляет. ★Не снимать, как встают, не снимать, как идут бок о бок, не снимать, как идут к двери, не снимать отъезд с уменьшением, не снимать поглощение светом.
·★Выражение в s3 обязано быть «мышцы смеха и мышцы плача работают одновременно»: ★в то время как уголки рта ещё тянутся вверх, внутренние концы бровей уже поднялись и выдавили вертикальные складки. Не сначала досмеялся, потом заплакал — у них есть зона наложения. Это самый важный пункт ролика.
·★Плача, он не закрывает лицо руками, не падает на колени и не бьёт кулаками по земле, не кричит, запрокинув голову, не рыдает навзрыд. Плач уходит вниз: голова опущена, плечи вздымаются, придыхания застревают в горле.
·★Пёс с s2 до удара в s6 ни разу не замедляется: не тормозит, не останавливается, не делает кругов. Он врезается напрямую.
·★Сбитый мужчина упадёт — это нормальный физический результат того, что крупный пёс ему по пояс врезается на полной скорости. Направление падения — вдоль оси импульса, назад-влево в кадре.
·★★Виляние ни в коем случае не означает, что движется только кончик хвоста: хвост тянет корень хвоста, корень хвоста тянет таз, таз тянет обе задние лапы, задние лапы заносит по облачной поверхности вбок, середина спины изгибается следом, даже лопатки раскачиваются. ★Вся задняя половина тела, как отдельный предмет, мотается влево-вправо с огромным размахом. Когда он виляет сильнее всего, он сам не может удержать центр тяжести, спотыкается на полшага и встаёт обратно.
·★В s7 облизывание и виляние обязаны происходить одновременно, нельзя разделять на «сначала долизал, потом виляет». Он виляет, продолжая лизать, и именно потому, что так увлечённо лижет, виляет ещё безумнее.
·★Композиция s7 обязана целиком сохранять в кадре всю заднюю половину пса и обе задние лапы, рамка кадра не должна их обрезать — этот план существует ради того, чтобы смотреть на это движение.
·★Пёс во всём ролике в расцвете сил: шерсть густая, тело здоровое, ★нет ошейника, нет поводка, на морде нет седины, на теле нет песка и мокрых следов.
·★Слёзы только на лице мужчины, пёс не плачет. В s6~s8 слёзы ещё текут, а уголки рта уже расслабились, одно сосуществует с другим без противоречия.
·★Не давать псу человеческую улыбку с поднятыми уголками рта — всю его радость играют сила бега, решительность удара и амплитуда зада.
·★В s1~s6 пёс движется из правой части кадра в левую. ★Во всём ролике нет никакого поступательного движения в правую сторону кадра, в этом эпизоде никто не уходит.
·★Соотношение яркостей трёх слоёв аномальное: облака переднего плана самые яркие, людей и пса видно за счёт «тёмного». Не меняется на протяжении всего ролика.
·★Кроме крупного плана лица в s3, в каждом плане передний, средний и задний планы обязаны иметь каждый свой явный источник света и уровень яркости, яркость трёх слоёв не совпадает. ★Светотень внутри s3 всё равно должна быть слоистой, плоский свет запрещён.
·★Дверь — только белая дверная рама и свет внутри двери. Нет символов, нет резьбы, нет надписей, нет крыльев, нет нимба. ★Это лишь задний план, в этом ролике никто к ней не идёт.
·★Радуга — выбеленные светом низконасыщенные широкие мазковые полосы, не светится, без частиц.
·★Не помечать в кадре секунды, таймкод, номера планов.
·Во всём ролике ровно два живых существа: мужчина 1 + пёс 1. Нет других людей, нет второго животного, нет зевак. Ни в одном кадре никто не смотрит в камеру.
·Во всём ролике нет текста в кадре и субтитров.

【Исключения】встают, идут бок о бок, идут к двери, отъезд с уменьшением, поглощение светом, любая форма ухода; фотореализм, материалы живой съёмки, ощущение 3D-рендера по умолчанию, пластиковая кожа, чистые CG-блики, cel-контур, японская 2D-анимация, ударные кадры, замедленная съёмка, смена скорости, размытие в движении, таймлапс, растворение, наплыв, смазанная панорама, монтаж по совпадению, сплит-скрин, сетка 3×3, 8K и слова качества вроде «шедевр», бьюти-свет, ретушь кожи, «божественные лучи», блики объектива, объёмный туман, светящиеся частицы, звёздные искры, световые столбы, яркая насыщенная реалистичная радуга, крылья, нимб, религиозные символы, резные украшения, фоновая музыка, струнные, хор, сердцебиение, колокольный звон, звон ветряных колокольчиков, текст в кадре, субтитры, водяной знак, логотип бренда, ошейник, поводок, виляет только хвост без задней половины тела, обрезанная задняя половина тела, второй пёс, второе животное, толпа, зеваки, закрывать лицо руками, рыдать навзрыд, запрокинув голову, падать на колени и бить кулаками по земле, персонаж смотрит в камеру, встречается взглядом с камерой, позирует для камеры, ломает четвёртую стену, композиция с героем точно в центре, пустое серое незаполненное пространство, зеркальное отражение, перестановка лево-право между планами.
items.prompt_en:
【Metadata】Arcane-style painterly stylized 3D animation / single 30-second generation / 16:9 / audio on / 8 shots, hard cuts / no dialogue, no voice-over, no background music anywhere / ★shot durations are decided by the generator itself; this prompt specifies no seconds at all, only the shot order and the hard-cut points / structure: joy → breakdown → head drops → sprint → knocked down → licking non-stop → the whole rear wagging like crazy → ending inside that lying heap

【Reference slots】
视频1 = the previous finished segment (the man waiting on the clouds, the visitor in white leaving, up to the dog running in from the rainbow bridge). ★Inherit only the art style, brushstroke density, the overexposed lighting logic on the clouds, the identity traits of both protagonists and their size relationship, and the direction axis of the dog running from frame right to frame left. ★Do not inherit any composition, camera positions, camera moves or editing rhythm.
image1 = 삽살개 (sapsali, adult dog); take only identity traits (coat colour proportions, facial features, coat texture).
image2 = the man; take only identity traits (face shape, facial features, hairstyle, build).
★This segment is a direct continuation of the previous one: at the opening the dog is already running toward him on the rainbow bridge, and the man has already stood up and seen it. Do not replay the waiting, do not replay the visitor in white, do not replay the real-world hospital room.

【★Ending lock — most important】★This segment does not show standing up, does not show walking side by side, does not show walking toward the door, does not show any act of leaving. ★The last shot stops in the state where the two bodies are still lying on the cloud surface, the dog is still licking him, and its rear is still wagging. ★Do not add at the end any shot of getting up, pulling out, shrinking, or being swallowed by light. The landing point of this segment is "still romping", not "gone".

【Character nano-anchors】
●The man: ★back to his best self in his thirties. Short black hair #14161C with no grey, square face with defined cheekbones, straight nose bridge, hard jawline, heavy eyelids, slightly drooping outer eye corners. Warm skin tone #C98F6A~#A86E4E. Wears an off-white cotton shirt #EDE6D8 (sleeves rolled to the elbows, collar open) + dark navy trousers #14161C, barefoot. ★His dark navy trousers are the only dark colour in this white world that belongs to him. Not to be changed.
●삽살개 (sapsali; adult, in its prime): this is image1. ★Size = standing, its shoulder/back height reaches an adult man's waist; thick, powerful legs; unmistakably a large dog. Centre of the face, neck and chest: cream-white long hair #E7DCC4; around the eyes, ears, back and flanks: ink-black long hair #1A1A1E. The forelock fully covers the eyes; through the gaps the black irises #2A1E16 glint like wet glass. Nose dark grey #4A4A50. ★The coat is fluffy and dry, edges shot through with light; ★no collar, no leash, no grey on the muzzle, no sand or wet marks on the body.
　★★Tail motion spec — the single most important item in this piece: its tail is thick and strong, but ★when it wags, it is absolutely not just the tail moving. The order is: the tail drives the tail root, the tail root drives the whole hip, the hip drives both hind legs, ★so the entire rear half swings left and right in huge arcs like a separate thing, so large that ★the hind legs can't hold their footing, get flung half a step sideways, skidding on the cloud surface, push back, and get flung out again. ★The middle of the spine twists along with it, even the shoulder blades are made to sway. ★This is the same movement it made as a puppy chasing him through the alley on a rainy night, only the body is now ten times bigger, so the amplitude is ten times bigger too. ★At its wildest, it can't even keep its own centre of gravity.
●Bench: a worn solid-wood bench standing on the cloud surface far off on the left of frame; only a small piece of armrest shows in the background of s1.
●Door: ★at the end of the rainbow bridge stands a simple white door frame; inside the door is a patch of light brighter than its surroundings. ★Only the frame and the light — no symbols, carvings, text or decorations. ★It exists only as background; nobody walks toward it in this piece.

【Shot structure】Single 30-second generation, 8 shots, hard cuts. ★No seconds specified — the generator allocates by content, but the weight must fall on three shots: s3 (the breaking face), s6 (the licking) and s7 (the rear wagging like crazy); these three should be the longest in the piece. State is continuous; only the camera jump-cuts. Every shot boundary = an instantaneous frame change. Do not interpret as dissolves, cross-fades, match cuts, whip-pan transitions, disguised long takes, or separately generated independent clips.
　s1 medium shot, eye level — first, joy
　s2 medium-wide shot pushing in — it hasn't slowed by a single step
　s3 facial close-up — the smiling face collapses
　s4 medium shot, slightly high — the head drops
　s5 low angle hugging the ground — the last few steps
　s6 low wide → high-angle top-down — knocked down → licking non-stop
　s7 medium shot, slightly low — the whole rear is wagging
　s8 high-angle top-down — ending inside this heap

【Voice lock — affirmative, mandatory】★No dialogue, no voice-over, no intelligible human voice anywhere in the piece. The man does not speak. ★When he cries, broken, short breathy sounds and gasps squeezed out of his throat are allowed — but not forming words, not wailing, not lines. ★After s6 he is allowed to laugh out loud, but that laugh always has the breathy sounds of crying mixed in; the two can't be separated. No subtitles.

【Head count — affirmative】★Exactly two living beings in the whole piece: man 1 + dog 1. On the clouds there are no other people, no second animal, no onlookers, no visitor in white. There is only one dog in every shot.

【★Three-layer lighting master lock — inviolable in every shot】Every shot must have foreground, midground and background layers at the same time, and ★the light of each of the three layers must be specified separately: what light source, from which direction, which surface it hits first, and where it sits in brightness. The three layers must not share the same brightness. ★No layer may be left as a grey plane with no substance and no lighting description.
　Unified lighting for the piece: ★there is no single light source. Light glows out from inside the cloud layer as a whole — a directionless, overexposed milky white #F6F0E4. The edges of every object are shot through by light into a translucent velvety rim; shadows are extremely faint and have no clear direction. ★The only truly dark areas in this space are three: the man's dark navy trousers, the dog's ink-black long hair, and the dark parts of the wood grain on the solid-wood bench. The rainbow crosses the background as four wide brush bands in extremely low saturation: pale pink, pale apricot, pale cyan, pale violet.
　★The brightness relationship of the three layers in this piece is inverted: ★the cloud wisps in the foreground are the brightest, the man and dog in the midground second, the rainbow and door in the background third. ★So the subjects are seen by being "dark", not by being "bright". This holds for the whole piece.
　★General rule: light always lands first on the cloud surface and the rainbow bands; the man and dog only receive diffuse light bounced back from the cloud surface. No light hits a face directly; faces are always wrapped by white from all sides.
　★Exception clause: s3 is a facial close-up and may lack clear foreground and background entities; the background may be fully blurred white and colour bands — ★but the light and shade inside the face must still be layered: the forehead and tops of the cheekbones are the lit planes, the cheeks the transition planes, the eye sockets and sides of the nose a very faint warm-grey shadow plane. No flat lighting.

【Colour ratio】60% = overexposed milky white #F6F0E4 (clouds and light). 30% = the man's dark navy trousers and the dog's ink-black long hair (the only two truly dark masses in the piece). 10% = the washed-out rainbow bands and the warm brown of the wooden bench. ★No indigo shadows anywhere, no strongly saturated colours at all.

【Surface ownership lock — affirmative, mandatory】Overexposed translucent rims = belong to the outlines of every object in frame. ★Tears = only on the man's face, welling from the lower eyelids and sliding down along the cheekbones; the dog does not cry. ★Wet marks = only on the man's cheekbones, jaw and shirt collar; they do not spread elsewhere. ★Saliva = only on the patches of cheek the dog has licked, a thin layer of wet sheen that grows with each lick. Cloud wisps = scatter only when stepped on, slammed into, pressed down or scuffed by hind legs; otherwise they drift slowly. Eye highlights = a single point on the iris surface of the man and the dog. Brushstroke texture = present on all surfaces; only the eyeballs and the wet nose tip remain smooth single planes.

【Motion speed lock — affirmative, mandatory】All motion at natural 1x speed. ★Everything on the clouds is half a beat slower than reality: fabric falls slowly, cloud wisps drift slowly, hair floats slowly. ★There are only two exceptions: ① the running and colliding dog — the fastest and heaviest motion in the piece; ★it never slows down once until impact. ② ★the rear half during wagging — the motion with the largest amplitude and highest frequency in the piece, swinging so hard it can't stay on its feet. The man's emotional movements (mouth corners, brows, trembling shoulders) are at real speed, not slowed. ★No slow motion, no speed ramps, no impact zooms, no time distortion.

【Emotional tone lock — affirmative, mandatory】
★This is the only piece in the whole series where emotion is allowed to come out, but there are still rules:
　· The man's emotion goes through three stages, none may be skipped: ★① pure joy (s1~s2) — mouth open, brows raised, body leaning forward. ★② breakdown (s3) — ★key: the laughing muscles and the crying muscles work at the same time, not laughing first and then crying. The mouth corners are still pulling up while the inner ends of the brows have already lifted and squeezed out vertical creases; the lower lip begins to tremble; the chin muscles bunch into a small wrinkled knot; the eyes first widen, then fill with tears. ★This is the face of "so happy it's unbearable", not a sad face. ③ letting go (s4) — head down, shoulders heaving hard, breathy sounds that can't get out of his throat.
　· ★From start to finish he does not cover his face with both hands, does not kneel and pound the ground, does not look up to the sky. The crying goes downward, not outward as a cry.
　· s6~s8 after the reunion = ★crying and laughing on the face at once; tears still flowing, mouth corners already truly relaxed. ★By the end he is smiling, but his face is still wet.
　· The dog = an animal's face; ★do not give it a human-style upturned smile. ★Its joy is played entirely by three things: how hard it runs, how unreservedly it crashes in, ★and how big its rear wags — the third is the focus of this piece.

【Style lock — Arcane painterly medium manifesto】Hand-painted stylized 3D: brushstrokes clearly visible, flowing along the forms and flowing away with motion. Highlights are painterly glints broken up by brush marks, not clean CG specular spots. Skin, hair and fabric carry the paint texture of oil and gouache; cloth folds and cheekbones are hard-edged brush planes. The whole frame is covered with paper texture and canvas grain. Forms are 3D sculpted volumes; surfaces are 2D painting. ★Not cel animation, no 2D black outlines; not photoreal, not live action.
　● ★The clouds are not volumetric fog but layer upon layer of thick impasto milky-white brush planes with rough edges. The rainbow is four flatly laid wide brush bands, colours pressed down to extreme paleness.
　● The dog's long hair is directional clumps of coarse strokes; when running they are pulled along the velocity direction into long backward strokes; ★when wagging, the long hair of the whole rear half swings alternately left and right and the stroke direction flips over as a whole — the largest-amplitude brushstroke motion in the piece; when ruffled, coarse stroke clumps in conflicting directions.
　● ★Tears are not glistening droplets but two extremely fine wet brush lines a little brighter than their surroundings.
　● ★In the overexposure the skin has almost no terminator line; emotion is read entirely through muscle-driven deformation (vertical creases between the brows, the wrinkled knot of the chin, the direction of the mouth corners), not through lighting.
　● Style tag in English (this line only): hand-painted stylized 3D, painterly brushstrokes, oil and gouache texture, paper grain, not cel-shaded, not photoreal.

【Composition and direction lock — inviolable in every shot】
① The camera is a witness who happens to be there. ★The man and the dog never look at the camera in any frame. All eyelines are bound to real objects inside the frame — he looks at the dog, the dog looks at him. ★Even while his face is being licked, even while lying on the ground, he does not turn his face to the camera.
② ★Do not place characters at dead centre. The subject's head falls on the left third line, eye level on the upper third line; the large space on the other side is filled by clouds, the rainbow and the distant door. Even when centring is necessary, offset half a step from dead centre, to the left.
③ ★Direction axis:
　· s1~s6: ★the man is on the left of frame; the dog runs in from far frame right toward frame left. ★This is the direction of "coming back"; it may not be flipped.
　· s6 impact: ★the momentum continues along the same axis — the man is knocked over toward frame left-rear, and the cloud wisps scatter to the left.
　· s7~s8: ★the two bodies lie in the left third of frame, the dog on his right. The left-right relationship does not change.
　· ★There is no travelling movement toward frame right anywhere in the piece. Nobody leaves in this segment.

―――― Shot breakdown ――――

【s1 / medium shot, eye level, fully locked / cut, continuous state】First, joy
◇Foreground (brightest layer): a thick impasto milky-white cloud wisp at the lower right edge of frame, almost touching the lens and drifting slowly toward frame left, lit through from inside — ★this layer is brighter than the man.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light wraps him from all sides. The man stands in the left third of frame, waist-up, top of the head on the upper third line. ★His off-white shirt almost merges with the white background; only the hard edges of the folds and the dark navy waistband separate him from the light. Eyeline = he looks into the distance toward frame right, eyes opening wider and wider.
◇Background (colour-band layer): the washed-out rainbow rises from lower left to upper right of frame; ★far off on the bridge a small dark dot is getting bigger. At the very left edge of frame a small piece of the wooden bench's armrest is visible.
◇Performance: when the shot opens he is already standing upright. ★His eyebrows lift all the way up and two horizontal lines appear on his forehead; his mouth involuntarily opens a crack, his jaw drops a little. This is pure joy with nothing mixed in yet. He takes half a step forward — only half a step — then stops, as if afraid he's seeing things. His hands at his sides open and close. ★Then the corners of his mouth pull up sharply into a real smile; his shoulders drop loose all at once, his chest rises twice, his breathing gets faster and shallower. He takes another step forward, his right hand unconsciously rising and reaching toward frame right — palm open, as if beckoning.
◇Camera: eye-level medium shot, camera fully locked. ★No push, no pan — but the subject is alive: breathing, slight shifts of the pupils, facial muscles constantly moving. ★No handheld anywhere in the cloud section. Intent = first give the cleanest stretch of joy in full, so the breakdown in the next shot has a drop.
◇Sound: ★a very faint high-altitude white noise with no reflections or echo. Fabric rustle, two muffled sounds of bare feet stepping on something soft, his quickening breath. ★No music, no strings, no sentimental lead-in sound of any kind.
◇Texture: the shirt folds are hard-edged brush planes. The two forehead lines and the direction of the mouth corners are deformations that create the expression, not shadows. Paper texture across the frame.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s2 / medium-wide → push-in / cut, continuous state】It hasn't slowed by a single step
◇Foreground (brightest layer): thick impasto cloud wisps along the bottom and right edges of frame, lit through, drifting left; the brightest layer in frame.
◇Midground (running layer): ★the washed-out rainbow bridge deck runs diagonally from upper right to lower left of frame. ★The dog is running flat out along the deck toward frame left. As it closes in, the ink-black hair on its back becomes clearer and clearer against the overexposed white; ★the long hair is pulled along the velocity direction into long backward strokes, all four paws land powerfully, and cloud wisps burst behind it where it steps. ★It wears no collar, no leash. Eyeline = its eyes are locked on the man at frame left.
◇Background (colour-band layer): higher piled clouds and a brighter sky; the white door frame at the end of the bridge, upper right of frame, pushed out of frame as the camera pushes in.
◇Performance: four legs alternate in full extension; the muscles of the shoulder blades and hind legs push and roll under the long hair — this is a completely healthy dog holding nothing back. ★It leaps over a drop in the clouds on the bridge, legs stretched into a single line in the air; on landing its front paws sink deep into the cloud and push out again, losing no speed at all. Ears pressed flat back by the wind, mouth open panting, tongue flopping to one side. ★The forelock is blown open by the airflow, and through the gap those black eyes are clearly visible for the first time. ★It's closer — close enough to see the white hair on its chest heaving hard with each breath. ★Still not slowing down.
◇Camera: starts as a medium-wide shot and makes one continuous, steady push-in as it approaches. ★No handheld — the force comes from the dog itself. Intent = hand "it's come back" to one uninterrupted, ever-closer action.
◇Sound: ★for the first time a strong sound rises above the white noise: muffled thuds of four paws pounding something soft, approaching from afar and getting denser, the dog's heavy panting, the whoosh of air split by its body. No music.
◇Texture: the running long hair is bundles of coarse strokes stretched backward. The burst cloud wisps are a cluster of white brush dots flung backward. The dog's ink-black is the only dark mass in the overexposed white.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s3 / facial close-up, fully locked / cut, continuous state】The smiling face collapses ★★★
◇Frame composition: ★this shot is a facial close-up and may lack clear foreground and background entities. A blurred, light-shot cloud wisp may slide across the lower right edge of frame; the background is fully blurred white and rainbow bands. ★But the light and shade inside the face must be layered; no flat lighting.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light wraps the face from all sides. A close-up of the man's face, centre of the head on the left third, eye level on the upper third line. ★In this white the skin nearly loses its terminator; only the eye sockets and sides of the nose keep a very faint warm grey — ★so every emotion on this face must be read through muscle-driven deformation, not lighting. Eyeline = he watches the dog getting closer at frame right. ★Not the camera.
◇Performance: ★this shot is the core of the whole piece and should also be one of its longest shots. Three stages must happen continuously on the same face, without being cut:
　★Stage one, still laughing: mouth corners pulled high, cheekbones bunched up, eyes squeezed by laughter so the pads under the lower lids show. Breathing fast and shallow.
　★Stage two, the laugh hasn't stopped and something else arrives: ★the inner ends of the brows suddenly lift, squeezing two vertical creases between them — ★but the mouth corners are still turned up. This is that face: the laughing muscles and the crying muscles working at the same time. The lower lip begins to tremble, at first a tiny high-frequency tremor. The eyes are forced wide, and the water in them swells to the brim all at once.
　★Stage three, collapse: the chin muscles wrinkle into a small lumpy knot; the mouth corners are still pulling up, but the whole mouth has begun to sag downward; the nostrils flare, he sucks in a sharp breath, and his shoulders lift once with it. ★Two tears spill from the lower eyelids and slide down along the cheekbones — he doesn't blink; his eyes stay open, watching over there.
　★Close: he tries to smile once more; a mouth corner twitches and falls again. His Adam's apple rolls up and down once. ★A broken, short breathy sound squeezed out of his throat — not forming words. His head starts to sink.
◇Camera: facial close-up, camera fully locked. ★Throughout: no push, no pan, no orbiting, no impact zoom, no cut. ★Let this whole passage play out on its own in an unmoving frame. Intent = all the restraint of three whole films pays off on this one face.
◇Sound: his ever-faster breathing, a sharp intake of breath, one broken breathy sound that can't get out of his throat, white noise, the distant thuds of four paws getting closer. ★No music, no strings, no heartbeat, no emotion-guiding sound of any kind.
◇Texture: ★the tears are two extremely fine wet brush lines a little brighter than their surroundings, not glistening droplets. The creases between the brows, the knot of the chin and the direction of the mouth corners are all hard-edged deformation strokes. The skin is nothing but the texture of the strokes themselves.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s4 / medium shot, slightly high, fully locked / cut, continuous state】The head drops
◇Foreground (brightest layer): cloud wisps along the bottom edge of frame drifting left, lit through.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light. A slightly higher angle on his upper body; he stands in the left third of frame. ★He lowers his head deeply, chin nearly touching his chest, the back of his neck fully exposed; his short black hair is the largest dark mass from this angle. ★Both hands hang at his sides; he doesn't raise them to cover his face. Eyeline = he looks at the clouds at his feet.
◇Background (colour-band layer): the washed-out rainbow and the distant door frame, blurred into soft wide colour bands. ★The dark shape on the bridge is already very large and still closing in.
◇Performance: ★his shoulders begin to heave hard — once, twice, far bigger than breathing. The shirt folds on his back contract and release with them. ★Two or three choked breathy sounds squeezed out of his throat, each one with a sharp drop of the shoulders. ★He doesn't cry out silently, doesn't throw his head back, doesn't kneel. The crying goes downward. ★Tears drip from his lowered face straight onto the cloud surface at his feet; where they land the cloud swallows them, leaving no trace. One hand at his side clenches and unclenches. ★The thuds of four paws are very close now. He doesn't lift his head — but ★his ear twitches, his shoulders tense, and his body instinctively turns a fraction toward the sound.
◇Camera: slightly high medium shot, camera fully locked. ★No push, no pan. ★The slight downward angle makes him look smaller and more defenceless. Intent = don't shoot the face; let the back of the neck and the shoulders perform the crying.
◇Sound: a few broken breathy sounds stuck in the throat, big gulps of air, cloth rubbing as the shoulders heave, white noise, ★the approaching thuds of four paws getting louder and louder — the sound counts down for the audience. No music.
◇Texture: the skin at the back of the neck is broad, soft planes. The shirt folds on the back keep changing shape as the shoulders heave. The falling tears are two or three very short bright strokes.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s5 / low angle hugging the ground, rapid push with the sprint / cut, continuous state】The last few steps
◇Foreground (brightest layer): cloud wisps burst by the four paws along the bottom edge of frame, flying past almost touching the lens, lit through; the brightest layer.
◇Midground (sprint layer): ★directionless overexposed white light. An extremely low angle, almost on the cloud surface. ★The dog charges at full speed from frame right toward frame left, occupying the right two-thirds of frame; this angle makes it look enormous — chest, the drive of the forelegs, the white hair under the jaw all bearing down on the lens. ★It shows no sign whatsoever of slowing: ears flat, mouth wide open, tongue flopping to the right, front paws reaching farther with every stride. Eyeline = it stares at the person with his head down at frame left.
◇Background (colour-band layer): the washed-out rainbow behind it is stretched into blurred colour bands; ★at the very left edge of frame are the man's lower body, head bowed, and bare feet, still unaware how close it is.
◇Performance: ★Four strides. With each landing the shoulder blades compress hard and spring open, the long hair flipping back in one sheet. ★Three strides. Its hind legs push off even harder — ★not braking to stop, but accelerating to crash in. Cloud wisps burst behind it one after another. ★Two strides. Its eyes are fully open in the gap of the forelock, a highlight trembling in the black irises. ★One stride. Its whole body leaves the ground, front paws reaching forward, chest aimed straight at the person at frame left. ★This frame is the last frame before impact.
◇Camera: an extremely low angle skimming the cloud surface, making one rapid push-in with its sprint. ★One slight frame shake that comes with the anticipation of impact is allowed here, but the subject always stays clearly readable. ★No slow motion, no impact zoom. Intent = give the "sense of speed" to the lowest camera position, so the audience knows how heavy this hit will be.
◇Sound: four thuds of paws on something soft, from dense to densest, the dog's panting and nasal sounds cracking with excitement, the rustle of bursting cloud wisps, the white noise pushed to the bottom layer by these sounds. No music.
◇Texture: the long hair is stretched by speed into extremely long backward strokes, the highest stroke density in the piece. The cloud wisps flying past the lens are a cluster of out-of-focus white brush blocks.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s6 / low wide → (no cut within the shot; the camera swings from low angle to high-angle top-down) / cut, continuous state】Knocked down and licking non-stop ★★★
◇Foreground (brightest layer): at impact, cloud wisps scattered in all directions along the bottom and both sides of frame, flung in big clumps toward frame left and toward the lens; after the fall, cloud wisps along the four edges of frame drifting slowly out of frame — ★this layer is always brighter than the two lying bodies, like a white frame.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light.
　★First half (impact): low wide shot. ★The dog crashes in whole from frame right — chest makes contact first, front paws landing on the man's shoulders at the same moment; ★the man's upper body is pushed over by this force toward frame left-rear, his bare feet sliding some distance on the cloud surface before losing support. ★The two dark masses (his navy trousers, its ink-black hair) overlap into one heap in this instant — the first time in this film the two darks merge.
　★Second half (licking): the camera swings to look straight down from above. The man lies on his back on the cloud surface in the left third of frame; ★the dog is pressed fully on his chest, four legs braced on either side of him. ★From this angle the size difference reads — the dog's torso almost covers his entire upper body. Eyeline = the man's eyes watch the face that is licking him; the dog's eyes search for spots on his face.
◇Background (colour-band layer): the washed-out rainbow and the distant door frame lie quietly behind them, unaffected.
◇Performance:
　★Impact. It arrives without slowing down. He has only lifted his head halfway when he's hit — his upper body snaps back, his right foot pushes at the cloud surface and fails to hold. ★At the instant of impact both his hands instinctively come up and wrap around its neck. The two bodies fall together toward frame left-rear. His back hits the cloud first, and cloud wisps burst out in all directions from the contact point. ★As he lands, his head is cushioned by his own arms wrapped around the dog. The dog's momentum carries it fully on top of him. ★After landing there is a brief pause — neither body moves; only the cloud wisps are still falling.
　★Licking. Then it starts licking. ★Not gently, but urgently, one lick after another, utterly unable to stop: chin, cheekbones, nose bridge, beside the eyes, in front of the ears, back to the chin. ★Every stroke of the tongue tugs and deforms the skin of his face a little. ★It is especially fixated on the two lines where the tears ran, licking back and forth there several times. ★As he's being licked he laughs out loud — ★but that laugh still carries the breathy sounds of crying; the two sounds are mixed and can't be separated. He raises a hand to block, but the moment it's up his palm gets licked, so he just lets it fall and grabs the dog's neck. ★The dog's front paws keep trampling on his chest; each press squeezes a little air out of his ribcage. ★His face is licked completely wet, and his short hair is messed up and plastered to his forehead. ★With both hands he holds that big head and pulls it down, pressing his own forehead up against it. ★The dog's nose snorts on his face; both are panting. ★And throughout this whole stretch, at the bottom edge of frame its rear half can be seen swinging left and right the entire time — the licking and the wagging happen simultaneously and are never separated.
◇Camera: starts as a low wide shot skimming the cloud surface, swinging with the backward fall at impact; ★after they land, the camera swings within the shot to a high-angle shot looking straight down and settles. ★No violent handheld, no whip pans, no slow motion. ★No facial close-up in this shot: what we watch is "a mess", not expressions. Intent = say weight, chaos and size difference all at once in a single shot.
◇Sound: one solid muffled thud of impact, a breath knocked out of him, a second muffled thud as the two bodies land on something soft, the rustle of scattering cloud wisps, a brief pause, ★and then the densest group of effects in the piece: continuous wet sounds of a tongue across skin, the dog's rapid, excited nasal sounds and panting, his laughter mixed with crying and broken gasps, the muffled thumps of paws trampling his chest, ★the continuous rustle of the cloud surface swept by the swinging rear half. ★Still no music.
◇Texture: at the point of impact the two darks merge into one mass; coarse stroke clumps of long hair cover the hard-edged folds of the shirt. The scattering cloud wisps are a cluster of white brush blocks flung outward. The licked face has a thin layer of wet sheen; the messed-up hair is tufts of dark brush marks pointing in different directions. The dog's crushed, ruffled long hair is coarse stroke clumps in conflicting directions.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s7 / medium shot, slightly low, fully locked / cut, continuous state】The whole rear is wagging ★★★
◇Foreground (brightest layer): at the lower left edge of frame, the man's hand resting on the cloud surface and scattered cloud wisps, lit through, brighter than the midground.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light. A slightly low side angle: the man half sits up, propped on one hand behind him, in the left third of frame; ★the dog stands on his right, its front half still pinning his legs, its head at his face. ★The composition of this shot must keep the dog's entire rear half fully in frame — ★because this shot exists to watch that movement; it cannot be cropped. Eyeline = the dog's head is turned to his face; he looks at it.
◇Background (colour-band layer): the washed-out rainbow crosses behind them; the distant white door frame is at frame right.
◇Performance: ★this shot is the second heart of the piece and should also be among its longest shots.
　★The wagging mechanism must be performed in full: the tail moves first → the tail root is dragged along → ★the whole hip starts swinging left and right → both hind legs, flung by the hip, can't hold their footing, skid half a step sideways on the cloud surface, push back, and get flung out again → ★the middle of the spine twists along → ★even the shoulder blades are made to sway. ★The whole rear half is swinging like a separate thing. ★Cloud wisps scuffed by the hind legs scatter patch by patch, forming two churned-up clumps of white on either side of its rear.
　★And it wags while licking: ★its head keeps licking his face — one lick, back off half an inch, another lick, its head butting back and forth around his chin; ★at the same time the rear half has never stopped, and is even wagging more wildly because it's licking so eagerly. ★These two things must happen simultaneously; do not split them into "finish licking, then wag".
　★At its wildest it can't keep its own centre of gravity — ★its hind legs are flung out completely askew, a front paw slips once on his leg, it stumbles half a step and immediately stands back up, keeps licking, keeps wagging.
　★This time he doesn't dodge; he brings his forehead up to meet it. ★Tears are still running down his face, but his mouth corners have truly relaxed — ★crying and laughing on this face at the same time, without conflict. ★He raises one hand, pushes all five fingers into the long hair at the back of its neck, and strokes from the top of its head all the way to its shoulder blades — ★the same gesture as on the sofa in the first film. ★The dog's eyes half close, but ★the tail and rear don't slow down one bit.
◇Camera: slightly low side medium shot, camera fully locked. ★No push, no pan. ★The composition must keep the dog's rear half and both hind legs fully in frame, not cropped by the frame edge. Intent = hand "joy" entirely to the amplitude of the rear.
◇Sound: ★the continuous rustle of the cloud surface swept as the tail drives the rear half (the lead sound of this shot), the friction of hind legs skidding and stumbling, continuous wet licking sounds, his nasal laughter and breathing, the dog's excited panting and nasal sounds. No music.
◇Texture: ★the wagging rear half makes the whole sheet of long hair swing alternately left and right, the stroke direction flipping over as a whole — the largest-amplitude brushstroke motion in the piece. His fingers pushed into the fur press that patch of stroke clumps down and let it stand back up. The churned cloud wisps on either side of the rear are two white brush blocks with rough edges.
◇Transition: hard cut.

【s8 / high-angle top-down, fully locked / cut, continuous state】Ending inside this heap
◇Foreground (brightest layer): cloud wisps along the four edges of frame, lit through, drifting slowly out of frame — ★brighter than the heap in the middle, like a white frame surrounding them.
◇Midground (subject layer): ★directionless overexposed white light. Looking down from above: ★the man half lies, half sits on the cloud surface in the left third of frame, the dog pressed on top of him, the two bodies piled into one heap. ★One of his hands rests on the back of its neck, the other propped behind him. ★This top-down angle shows the size difference clearly: the dog's torso covers most of his upper body. Eyeline = he looks down at it, it looks up at him.
◇Background (colour-band layer): ★the washed-out rainbow stretches from beside them toward the upper right of frame; at its end that white door frame stands quietly, the light inside brighter than its surroundings. ★Nobody walks toward it.
◇Performance: ★neither makes big movements anymore, but neither has calmed down yet. His chest is still heaving, his breath nasal. ★The dog's head rests in the hollow of his shoulder; every so often it lifts to lick him once, then settles back down. ★Its tail is still wagging — smaller than before, but it never stops, and the cloud wisps behind it keep being swept into motion. ★His fingers close once on the back of its neck, then stay there. ★He glances up at the distant door, then looks back down at the dog. ★And the picture stops here: two bodies piled together, a tail still slowly wagging, and clouds drifting slowly all around.
◇Camera: high angle looking straight down, camera fully locked. ★No push, no pan, no pull-out, no shrinking. ★At the end, complete stillness, the frame doesn't move at all, but the subjects are alive: breathing, tail and cloud wisps all moving. ★No ending of being swallowed by light. Intent = give no "leaving", only "still together".
◇Sound: white noise, two sets of breathing (one big, one small; one slow, one fast), the continuous rustle of the tail sweeping the cloud surface, a wet lick every so often, short contented snorts from the dog's nose. ★The sound doesn't fade out or resolve — in the last frame the tail can still be heard moving. No music, no choir, no closing sound accents of any kind.
◇Texture: where the two bodies overlap, the coarse stroke clumps of long hair and the hard-edged shirt folds collide. The not-yet-dry wet marks on his face are a few fine brush lines a little brighter than their surroundings. The paper texture is clearest in the last frame.
◇Transition: ★the clip ends, no hard cut, no cut to black, no fade-out, no pull-out. Last frame = the two bodies piled together, a tail still wagging, and the drifting clouds all around.

【Audio mix】★No dialogue, no voice-over, no background music anywhere in the piece. ★The bottom layer is always a very faint high-altitude white noise with no reflections or echo. Effects (four paws, impact, licking, tail sweeping clouds, hind legs skidding, breathing) are all clearly placed in front of the white noise. ★Sound density curve: s1 sparse → s2~s5 gradually denser → ★s6~s7 densest in the piece (impact, licking, panting, crying-laughing and tail sweeping clouds all at once) → s8 drops back slightly but does not stop. ★s3 and s4 get no music, no strings, no heartbeat — only his breathing, the breathy sounds, and the ever-closer sound of four paws. ★The sound of the last frame does not fade out; the tail is still audible. No subtitles.

【★Repeated-error prevention★】
· ★The piece must stop in the state of the two bodies lying together with the tail still wagging. ★No standing up, no walking side by side, no walking toward the door, no pull-out-and-shrink, no being swallowed by light.
· ★The expression in s3 must be "laughing muscles and crying muscles working at the same time": ★while the mouth corners are still pulling up, the inner ends of the brows have already lifted and squeezed out vertical creases. Not laughing to the end and then crying — the two overlap. This is the single most important item in the piece.
· ★When he cries he does not cover his face with both hands, does not kneel and pound the ground, does not cry out to the sky, does not wail. The crying goes downward: head bowed, shoulders heaving, breathy sounds stuck in the throat.
· ★From s2 until impact in s6 the dog never slows down once — no braking, no stopping, no circling. It crashes straight in.
· ★The man who is hit will fall — this is the normal physical result of a waist-high large dog slamming into him at full speed. The fall goes along the momentum axis, toward frame left-rear.
· ★★Wagging is absolutely not just the tip of the tail moving: the tail drives the tail root, the tail root drives the hip, the hip drives both hind legs, the hind legs get flung skidding sideways on the cloud surface, the middle of the spine twists along, even the shoulder blades sway. ★The whole rear half swings hugely left and right like a separate thing. At its wildest it can't keep its own centre of gravity, stumbles half a step and stands back up.
· ★In s7 licking and wagging must happen simultaneously, not split into "finish licking, then wag". It wags while licking, and wags even more wildly because it's licking so eagerly.
· ★The composition of s7 must keep the dog's entire rear half and both hind legs fully in frame, not cropped by the frame edge — this shot exists to show that movement.
· ★The dog is in its prime throughout: full coat, healthy build, ★no collar, no leash, no grey on the muzzle, no sand or wet marks on the body.
· ★Tears only on the man's face; the dog does not cry. In s6~s8 the tears are still flowing while his mouth corners have already relaxed; the two coexist without conflict.
· ★Do not give the dog a human-style upturned smile — its joy is performed entirely by the force of its run, the decisiveness of the crash, and the amplitude of its rear.
· ★In s1~s6 the dog moves from frame right to frame left. ★There is no travelling movement toward frame right anywhere in the piece; nobody leaves in this segment.
· ★The brightness relationship of the three layers is inverted: the foreground clouds are brightest, the man and dog are seen by being "dark". Unchanged throughout.
· ★Except for the s3 facial close-up, every shot's foreground, midground and background must each have a clear light source and brightness level, with the three layers at different brightness. ★Inside s3 the light and shade must still be layered; no flat lighting.
· ★The door is only a white door frame and the light inside it. No symbols, no carvings, no text, no wings, no halo. ★It is only background; nobody walks toward it in this piece.
· ★The rainbow is light-washed, low-saturation wide brush bands; it doesn't glow and has no particles.
· ★Do not mark seconds, timecode or shot numbers on screen.
· Exactly two living beings in the whole piece: man 1 + dog 1. No other people, no second animal, no onlookers. Nobody looks at the camera in any frame.
· No on-screen text or subtitles anywhere in the piece.

【Exclusions】standing up, walking side by side, walking toward the door, pull-out-and-shrink, being swallowed by light, any form of leaving; photorealism, live-action footage, default 3D render look, plastic skin, clean CG highlights, cel outlines, Japanese 2D animation, impact frames, slow motion, speed changes, motion blur, time-lapse, dissolves, cross-fades, whip pans, match cuts, split screen, nine-grid, 8K and "masterpiece"-type quality words, beauty lighting, skin smoothing, god rays, lens flares, volumetric fog, glowing particles, starry sparkles, light pillars, vivid saturated realistic rainbow, wings, halo, religious symbols, carved ornaments, background music, strings, choir, heartbeat, bells, wind chimes, on-screen text, subtitles, watermark, brand logo, collar, leash, only the tail wagging without the rear half moving, cropped rear half, a second dog, a second animal, crowds, bystanders, covering the face with both hands, wailing at the sky, kneeling and pounding the ground, characters looking at the camera, eye contact with the camera, posing for the camera, breaking the fourth wall, dead-centre subject composition, empty grey negative space, mirror flipping, left-right swaps between shots.

【元数据】阿尔刻绘画感风格化3D动画 / 30秒单一生成物 / 16:9 / 开启音频 / 8镜硬切 / 全片无台词 无旁白 无背景音乐 / 镜头时长由生成端自行判断，本提示不指定秒数，只指定镜头顺序与硬切点 / 结构：高兴 → 崩溃 → 低头 → 冲刺 → 撞倒 → 舔个不停 → 屁股摇疯了 → 停在躺着的那一团里

【参考素材槽位】
视频1 = 前一段完成片(男人在云上等待、白衣来客离去、狗从彩虹桥奔来为止)。只继承画风、笔触密度、云上过曝光照逻辑、两位主角身份特征与体量关系、狗由画面右向左奔跑的方向轴；不继承构图、镜位、运镜与剪辑节奏。
image1 = 삽살개(成犬)，只取身份特征(毛色配比、五官、毛质)。

【s8 / 高角俯拍、完全锁定】停在这一团里
前景：四边透亮云絮缓慢向外流，比中间更亮，像白框。中景：他半躺半坐在左三分之一，狗压在他身上叠成一团；他一只手停在它后颈，另一只撑在身后；狗躯干盖住他大半上半身。他低头看它，它抬头看他。后景：淡彩虹向右上延伸，尽头白色门框静立，门内更亮；没有人朝它走去。
表演：都没有大动作，但都没安静。他胸口起伏，呼吸带鼻音。狗头搁在他肩窝，隔一会儿抬起舔他一下再搁回。尾巴还在摇，幅度变小但一直没停，云絮一直被扫动。他手指在它后颈收拢一次，然后停住。他抬头看一眼远处的门，又低头看它。画面停在：叠在一起的两具身体、一条还在慢慢摇的尾巴、四周缓缓流动的云。
摄影：正上方，不推、不摇、不拉出、不变小；最后画框静止，被摄者仍活着(呼吸、尾巴、云絮)。不做被光吃掉的收尾。声音：白噪、两组呼吸(一大一小、一慢一快)、尾巴扫云的持续沙沙、偶尔一声舔的湿响、狗满足的短哼；不淡出，最后一帧仍听得见尾巴在动；无音乐、合唱、收尾音效。片段结束：无硬切、不转黑、不淡出、不拉出。

【音频混音】无台词、旁白、背景音乐。底层始终是极轻无回声的高处白噪，动效(四爪、撞击、舔、尾巴扫云、后腿蹭滑、呼吸)置于白噪之前。密度：s1稀疏 → s2~s5渐密 → s6~s7最密 → s8略回落但不停。s3、s4无音乐、弦乐、心跳。不要字幕。

【排除项】站起来、并肩走、走向门、拉出变小、被光吃掉、任何离开；照片写实、实拍、默认3D渲染感、塑料皮肤、干净CG高光、赛璐璐描边、日式2D动画、冲击帧、慢动作、变速、运动模糊、延时、溶解、叠化、甩镜、匹配剪辑、分屏、九宫格、8K与"杰作"类画质词、美颜光、磨皮、耶稣光、镜头光晕、体积雾、发光粒子、星光、光柱、鲜艳写实彩虹、翅膀、光环、宗教符号、雕刻装饰、背景音乐、弦乐、合唱、心跳声、钟声、风铃声、画面文字、字幕、秒数与镜头编号标注、水印、品牌标志、项圈、牵引绳、只摇尾巴不动后半身、被裁掉的后半身、第二只狗、第二只动物、人群、旁观者、双手遮脸、仰天嚎啕、跪地捶地、人物看镜头、主体正中央构图、空白灰色留白、镜像翻转、镜头间左右对调。

items.title_ru: Стоп-моушен: отец отбивает метлу у гигантского монстра
items.title_en: Stop-motion: a father fights a giant monster for a broom
items.summary_ru: Пятнадцать секунд кукольной анимации в разгромленной тёмной гостиной: отец толкает монстра метлой, тот перехватывает и разворачивает её, отец пятится, давит бумажное ведро-тыкву и один раз бьёт монстра щёткой в морду, прикрывая сына в костюме привидения. Сложно: монстр стабильно в 1,7 раза выше отца во всех планах, точные хваты на твёрдой метле, склейки по таймкодам и ступенчатое стоп-моушен-движение.
items.summary_en: Fifteen seconds of puppet animation in a wrecked, dark living room: the father pushes the monster with a broom, the monster grabs and turns it, the father backs away, crushes a paper pumpkin bucket and strikes the monster in the face once with the bristles, shielding his son in a ghost costume. Hard: the monster consistently 1.7 times taller than the father in every shot, precise grips on a rigid broom, cuts on timecode and stepped stop-motion movement.

checks.detail_ru: Монстр выпрямившись примерно в 1,7 раза выше отца, голова почти у потолка, макушка отца на уровне нижних рёбер монстра; даже согнувшись, голова монстра минимум на полметра выше головы отца. Рука монстра примерно вдвое длиннее руки отца. Разница в росте одинакова во всех планах, монстр увеличен целиком, а не вытянуты ноги или шея.
checks.detail_en: Standing upright, the monster is about 1.7 times the father's height, its head almost at the ceiling, the top of the father's head at the level of the monster's lower ribs; even bent over, the monster's head is at least half a metre above the father's. The monster's arm is about twice as long as the father's. The height difference is the same in every shot; the whole monster is scaled up, not just stretched legs or neck.

checks.detail_ru: В комнате ровно два оранжевых бумажных ведра-тыквы по @prop_vedro_v1. Первое стоит неподвижно сразу за пятками отца и не сдвигается до контакта; в 5-м плане (около 8,85 с) правый ботинок отца, шагнувший назад, давит его за один шаг: стенка сминается и складывается вокруг ботинка, дальше оно остаётся раздавленным. Второе всё время цело на своём месте дальше позади.
checks.detail_en: The room has exactly two orange paper pumpkin buckets per @prop_vedro_v1. The first stands still right behind the father's heels and does not move until contact; in shot 5 (about 8.85 s) the father's right boot, stepping back, crushes it in one step: the wall crumples and folds around the boot, and it stays crushed afterwards. The second stays intact in its place farther back the whole time.

checks.detail_ru: Одна метла по @prop_metla: деревянная ручка со скруглённым концом, двойная красная обмотка, пучок соломы. Не гнётся, не удлиняется и не укорачивается при перехватах, не раздваивается, руки видимо касаются ручки.
checks.detail_en: One broom per @prop_metla: wooden handle with a rounded end, double red binding, straw bristle bundle. It does not bend, lengthen or shorten when grips change, does not split in two, and hands visibly touch the handle.

checks.detail_ru: 1-й план: обе руки отца на ручке, правая сразу за обмоткой, левая у бедра. 2-й: пальцы монстра по одному смыкаются на пучке у обмотки. 3-й: монстр левой рукой держит обмотку, поднимает щётку вертикально, разворачивает метлу и правой хватает скруглённый конец ручки; дальше монстр держит оба внешних конца, отец обеими руками середину. Хотя бы одна рука отца всё время на метле.
checks.detail_en: Shot 1: both of the father's hands on the handle, right just behind the binding, left near his hip. Shot 2: the monster's fingers close one by one on the bristles at the binding. Shot 3: the monster holds the binding with its left hand, lifts the bristles to vertical, turns the broom and grabs the rounded end of the handle with its right; from then on the monster holds both outer ends and the father holds the middle with both hands. At least one of the father's hands is on the broom at all times.

checks.detail_ru: 7-й план, около 11,9 с: после короткого приседа отец рывком вперёд-вверх вырывает метлу из когтей и один раз бьёт пучком в морду монстра. Левая рука монстра раскрывается во время рывка, правая отпускает при ударе. Второго удара нет.
checks.detail_en: Shot 7, about 11.9 s: after a short crouch, the father jerks forward and up, tears the broom out of the claws and strikes the monster's face once with the bristles. The monster's left hand opens during the jerk; the right lets go on impact. No second blow.

checks.detail_ru: Жёсткие склейки на 1,5 / 2,75 / 5,25 / 8,0 / 10,0 / 11,25 / 12,5 с, каждый план со статичной камерой и своей крупностью (за плечом монстра, инсерт щётки, низкий бок, верхний ракурс, ботинки у пола, лицо отца, монстр с позиции отца). Монстр всегда на стороне дивана, отец к нему лицом и спиной к сыну, сын близко позади и не попадает под метлу.
checks.detail_en: Hard cuts at 1.5 / 2.75 / 5.25 / 8.0 / 10.0 / 11.25 / 12.5 s, each shot with a static camera and its own framing (over the monster's shoulder, bristle insert, low side, high angle, boots at floor level, father's face, monster from the father's position). The monster is always on the sofa side, the father faces it with his back to his son, and the son stays close behind and out of the broom's reach.

checks.detail_ru: Кукольная анимация со ступенчатым, но гибким движением: антиципация, разгон, нагруженный контакт и отдача; монстр тяжёлый и чуть запаздывает. Не плавная 3D-интерполяция и не ускоренное движение.
checks.detail_en: Puppet animation with stepped yet supple movement: anticipation, acceleration, loaded contact and recoil; the monster is heavy and slightly delayed. Not smooth 3D interpolation and not sped-up motion.

checks.detail_ru: Тёмная холодная приглушённая картинка по @ref_horror_atmosphere_01: свет из окна, глубокие тени, тёплые акценты только от свечей и тыкв, электрические лампы выключены. Упавшие шторы и карниз, перевёрнутый стол, сдвинутый диван, ковёр и игрушки на своих местах по @ref_sh600_action_05; рефы не появляются вставками или титрами.
checks.detail_en: A dark, cool, subdued look per @ref_horror_atmosphere_01: window light, deep shadows, warm accents only from candles and pumpkins, electric lights off. Fallen curtains and rod, overturned table, displaced sofa, rug and toys in their places per @ref_sh600_action_05; references do not appear as inserts or titles.

checks.detail_ru: После удара монстр отшатывается к дивану, отец прикрывает сына рукой, метла у отца целиком; второе ведро цело, первое лежит раздавленным.
checks.name_en: Final: stagger and shielding the son
checks.detail_en: After the blow the monster staggers back toward the sofa, the father shields his son with his arm, and the broom is in the father's hands, whole; the second bucket is intact and the first lies crushed.

items.prompt:
MULTISHOT — THE PUSH, THE GRAB, THE BUCKET AND THE BLOW
15 seconds · 8 shots · 21:9 · 24 fps · stop-motion
SCENE CONTEXT
In a dark, wrecked living room a father fights a giant monster for a broom. The monster grabs the broom and turns it, the father is forced back and crushes a paper bucket underfoot, then strikes the monster's face once with the bristles. The monster staggers back while the father shields his son.
REFERENCES
@[ref_sh600_action_05](540be102-df99-4717-a6d5-4bd103319ca7) — room geography, materials, furniture and the post-crash environment only.
@[char_monster_v12](bc8c7222-250d-48fc-9c14-bd03a31cb322) — monster identity, proportions and materials: fuzzy black wool-like body, round black head with one deep empty eye socket and a wide grin of white teeth, very long thin arms, long bony fingers with curved black claws. Its size is set by MONSTER SCALE below.
@[father](ceb373fb-2b32-4955-b2f5-e7379d1e55fd) — father identity, proportions, clothing and materials: black messy hair, thick mustache and goatee, red-and-cream plaid shirt with rolled sleeves, dark apron, brown corduroy trousers, tan suede boots.
@[son](02f8f8aa-17d4-4f7d-bd44-06e04209e743) — son identity and white ghost costume.
@[prop_metla](45983ebf-c0cc-468c-b96d-159fbeff81be) — one rigid broom: wooden handle with a rounded end, double red binding, straw bristle bundle.
@[prop_vedro_v1](4db33a65-49dc-434a-a0e4-81a6184b5f24) — exactly two existing orange paper jack-o'-lantern buckets with black drawn faces, tape patches and thin wire handles.
All references define identity, materials and environment only. Every camera, framing and action comes from the shot blocks below. Reference images never appear as overlays, inserts or titles.
MONSTER SCALE
The monster is a giant next to the father. Standing upright it is about 1.7 times the father's height, its head almost touching the ceiling. Upright, the father's head reaches only the monster's lower ribs. Throughout the struggle the monster leans forward over the father, and even bent, its head stays at least half a meter above the father's head. Its arms are much longer than the father's, its grip span on the broom is about twice his, and its hand is about twice the length of the father's hand. Scale the whole monster up evenly, keeping the proportions of its reference; do not stretch only the legs or neck. The father always looks up at the monster's face. The size difference stays identical in every shot.
LIGHTING
@[ref_horror_atmosphere_01](6911ed08-e455-40a0-a15e-6938159225da) is authoritative for lighting, exposure, colour, contrast and atmosphere throughout. Preserve its dark, cool, subdued look, muted window light and deep shadows. Small warm accents come only from existing candles and jack-o'-lanterns. Electrical lights remain off.
Transfer atmosphere without copying this reference's camera, composition, objects or character positions. Other references do not override its lighting.
SPATIAL CONTINUITY
One continuous struggle in one room, shown through eight steady cameras with hard cuts on action at the exact times below. The monster always stands on the sofa side of the room, the father faces it with his back toward the son. Preserve body positions, grip states, broom orientation, gaze direction, momentum and the monster's towering height and forward lean across cuts.
The fallen curtains and rod, overturned table, displaced sofa, rug and scattered toys retain their world positions.
One intact bucket stands on the floor immediately behind the father, in his backward path. It stays stationary until his boot crushes it in SHOT 5, then remains crushed. The second bucket stays intact farther back in its established position. The son stays close behind the father, clear of the broom.
ANIMATION
Handmade puppet stop-motion with supple, stepped movement. Force travels from planted feet through hips, torso, shoulders and arms. Use brief anticipation, acceleration, loaded contact and recoil. The monster moves with the heavy, slightly delayed inertia of a large body: long reach, slow powerful weight shifts, slower recoveries. Keep the broom rigid and constant in length, with visible hand contact and natural inertia. Fit the action into 15 seconds by shortening pauses, not by speeding up movement.
SHOT 1 — 0.0–1.5 s — THE PUSH
Camera: over-the-shoulder from behind the monster's right side, camera at the father's chest height, 1.5 m behind the monster, 47° diagonal field of view, static. The monster's dark, out-of-focus side fills the left third of the frame (x 0–30%) and rises out of the top edge. The father stands at x 70%, seen from the waist up, facing screen-left toward the monster. A dark wall with a framed picture sits behind him in soft focus.
The first frame already shows the father pushing: both hands on the handle, right hand just behind the red binding, left hand back near his hip. The bristle bundle presses into the monster's belly at x 35%, at the father's chest height. The monster's black clawed hand hovers above the bristles at the top left, fingers curled. The father drives forward with steady pressure, teeth bared, brows down; the monster's body resists and barely gives.
SHOT 2 — 1.5–2.75 s — HARD CUT: THE GRAB
Camera: insert close-up, side view of the broom head, 29° diagonal field of view, 1.5 m away, static. The bristle bundle fills the left half pointing screen-left, the red binding sits at x 55%, the handle runs to screen-right where the father's right fist grips it at x 85%. A bright window glows white and soft in the background.
1.5–2.0 s: the monster's huge black hand, about twice the size of the father's hand, descends from the top of the frame. 2.0–2.3 s: its long fingers close one after another around the bristle bundle right at the red binding and lock into a tight, loaded grip. The father's fist tightens in answer.
SHOT 3 — 2.75–5.25 s — HARD CUT: THE TURN AND SECOND GRIP
Camera: low side view, camera 40 cm above the floor, 2.5 m from the pair, tilted up, 84° diagonal field of view, static; the ceiling is visible. The monster stands at screen-left in profile facing right, its round head near the top edge, far above the father's head. The father stands at screen-right in profile facing left, leaning into the push. The bright window sits between them in the background, dark teal walls and an armchair behind.
2.75–3.25 s: the father pushes the bristles into the monster's chest; the monster's free RIGHT arm rises high, claws spread.
3.25–3.75 s: holding the binding with its LEFT hand, the monster lifts the bristle end up; the broom swings to vertical, bristles high above the father's head. The father keeps both hands on the lower handle.
3.75–4.0 s: the monster drags the bristle end down toward its own LEFT side, turning the broom so the wooden handle end swings toward the monster.
4.0–4.25 s: the monster's RIGHT hand comes down and clamps the rounded wooden end of the handle.
4.25–5.25 s: the monster holds both outer ends, its arms spanning much wider than the father's. The father grips the middle with both hands, the broom level at his waist between their bodies. Tug of war: the monster bends its grinning head down toward the father's face, the father strains back, teeth clenched. At least one of the father's hands keeps contact at all times.
SHOT 4 — 5.25–8.0 s — HARD CUT: THE STRUGGLE
Camera: high angle from behind and above the monster's right shoulder, camera above the monster's head, looking down at about 40 degrees, 84° diagonal field of view, static. The monster's wide dark back and round head fill the lower-left foreground (x 0–45%) and rise clearly above the father's head; on screen the monster is about twice the father's height. The father faces camera at x 65%, looking up at the monster, holding the broom level across his chest with both hands in the middle; the monster's long arms reach to both outer ends. The son in the white ghost costume stands pressed close behind the father at x 82%. The intact orange bucket stands on the floor immediately behind the father's heels. Grey rug, scattered toy blocks at the left.
The monster bears down from above through its wide outer grip. The father braces through his middle grip, then retreats in two short backward steps. The son backs away slightly later, keeping clear. Cut before the father's next backward foot touches the bucket.
SHOT 5 — 8.0–10.0 s — HARD CUT: THE BUCKET
Camera: floor-level close-up, camera 15 cm above the floor, 1.2 m away, 47° diagonal field of view, static. The father's tan suede boots and brown corduroy trouser legs stand in the left third. The upright, intact orange paper bucket stands on the right, directly behind his heel. Soft room background with toys and window glow.
8.0–8.3 s: his feet shift under the pressure. 8.3–8.8 s: he lifts his right boot and moves it BACKWARD over the bucket. 8.85 s: the sole lands on the bucket's upper rim and crushes it in one step: the thin paper wall buckles, folds and splays flat around the boot. 8.9–10.0 s: his weight settles on the flattened bucket, his left boot stays planted, he remains standing. The bucket stays still until contact and does not slide under the boot. One step, one crush.
SHOT 6 — 10.0–11.25 s — HARD CUT: FATHER'S REACTION
Camera: frontal medium shot from the monster's side, camera slightly above the father's eye line, 1.5 m away, 47° diagonal field of view, static. The father is centered from the chest up, facing camera. Both his fists grip the broom level across the lower foreground; the bristles and red binding sit at the left frame edge; the monster's black claws grip the two outer ends at the left and right edges, and a dark blurred curve of its arm frames the right edge. Dark wall, framed picture and a lampshade behind him.
His eyes look up past the top of the frame toward the monster's face high above. His teeth clench, brows tighten, nostrils flare. He gathers his strength for one sharp jerk, grip tightening, shoulders loading.
SHOT 7 — 11.25–12.5 s — HARD CUT: ONE BLOW
Camera: medium shot of the monster from the father's side, camera at the father's shoulder height, slightly low angle, 47° diagonal field of view, static. The monster is centered, bent forward over the father, its round head and wide grin in the upper third, still above the father's head. Both its long arms reach down to the broom in the lower right, where the father's forearms enter from the right foreground. Bright window at the right, teal armchair, a coat rack with an orange coat, a lamp.
11.25–11.75 s: the monster leans in and pulls. 11.75–11.9 s: short anticipation, the father dips. 11.9 s: he jerks the broom forward and up, tearing it out of the monster's claws, and drives the bristle bundle into its face ONCE. The monster's left hand opens during the jerk, its right grip releases as the blow lands; the broom clears the monster's face and stays in both of the father's hands, full length, bristles forward. The monster's head snaps back and up, its grin still open.

SHOT 8 — 12.5–15.0 s — HARD CUT: THE STAGGER AND THE SHIELD
Camera: wide low shot from the window side of the room, camera 70 cm above the floor, 3.5 m from the pair, 84° diagonal field of view, static. The whole room is visible: the overturned table, the fallen curtains and rod, the displaced sofa behind the monster, the scattered toys on the grey rug. The monster stands at screen-left, the father and son at screen-right; the monster's head stays near the ceiling, about 1.7 times the father's height.

12.5–13.5 s: the monster staggers back two heavy, delayed steps toward the sofa, one long arm flung up across its face, the other clawed hand grasping at the air; its body sways with slow inertia. 13.5–14.5 s: the father takes half a step back, holds the broom forward in his right hand at a diagonal between them, bristles toward the monster, and sweeps his left arm back across the son. The son in the white ghost costume presses into the father's back and peeks out at hip height. The crushed bucket lies flat at the father's heels; the second bucket stands intact farther back. 14.5–15.0 s: hold. The monster stays hunched by the sofa, breathing; the father stands guard, broom raised, looking up at its face. The final frame holds on all three.
